name: Gods’ Shrine
description: At the Gods’ Shrine you can worship various gods to gain their grace. Your city’s main deity influences which blessings will benefit your city – at least as long as the deity is happy with your efforts. The shrine is a sign of your citizen’s reverence for the gods and each of them can be worshipped here.
Requirement(s): The Seat of the Gods
contentHtml:
At the Gods’ Shrine you can worship various gods to gain their grace. Your city’s main deity influences which blessings will benefit your city – at least as long as the deity is happy with your efforts. The shrine is a sign of your citizen’s reverence for the gods and each of them can be worshipped here.

Requirement(s): The Seat of the Gods
